ledger_node_role.definition: Node whose state restoration and peer data retrieval are performed within a hardware trusted execution environment to prevent tampering.
ledger_node_role.evidence: The bootstrapping operation involves communication between the Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) of the two or more nodes.

ledger_node_role.definition: Node authorised to mint digital assets recording asset type, asset value and first owner on the ledger.
ledger_node_role.evidence: at least some of the nodes are minting nodes

crypto_asset_scope_criteria.definition: Digital token whose recorded value is a complex number with two or more components, rather than a scalar quantity.
crypto_asset_scope_criteria.evidence: digital token values recorded in the distributed ledger include complex values having at least two components

unhosted_custody_control_policy.definition: Private key or seed split into shares distributed to multiple devices so that reconstruction requires several shares.
unhosted_custody_control_policy.evidence: dividing mnemonic information or a seed value for generating a key for electronically signing data

minting_mechanism.definition: New tokens minted and allocated to contributors in proportion to measured effects on network performance reported by other participants.
minting_mechanism.evidence: the portions are determined based on effects determined to be caused by members of the second set of entities on performance

consent_or_governance_trust_scoring.proposal: trust-score-based waiver of transfer waiting period
consent_or_governance_trust_scoring.definition: Trust score aggregated from user activity used to waive a waiting period for transactions above a threshold.
consent_or_governance_trust_scoring.evidence: assess the trust of one or more users to dispense with a waiting period

script_language_expressiveness.definition: Ledger uses a purpose-designed programming language to improve efficiency and security of the network.
script_language_expressiveness.evidence: The disclosed systems can also utilize a new programming language that improves efficiency and security
